source: research/bakery-architecture.md (nodes, edges, layers); research/bakery-case-study.md Part 2 §2 (module groups), Part 3 §4 (token contexts), Part 2 §3 (statuses)
note: Every node and edge carries the repo-relative file:line it was read from. Paths are relative to the plugin repo. The token node is the PHP map in includes/tokens.php; the generator/sync 'engine' was deferred and never built (docs/design-tokens.md:95), so the diagrams call it the token map. Staff first names in labels are replaced with 'the deli lead' (SPEC §1); the source paths are unchanged.

layers.label: Customer
layers.description: The person ordering, their browser, their inbox.

layers.label: Storefront
layers.description: The plugin's front-end screens and JS: shortcode page, shell, wizard, cart, checkout template, confirmation.

layers.label: WooCommerce engine
layers.description: WooCommerce as the engine: products and variations, the cart, checkout, WooPayments, orders, Action Scheduler, wp_mail.

layers.label: Staff
layers.description: The bakery's and the deli's operational screens and the printer path.

layers.label: Admin
layers.description: Configuration and maintenance: Settings tabs, importers, product screens, Health.

layers.label: Infrastructure
layers.description: GitHub Actions to WP Engine, the CLI harness, options storage, the token map.

nodes.label: Builder — modifier wizard steps (dietary → flavor → frosting → filling → decorations → message)
Checkout page (plugin templates on Woo's checkout)
Modifier Engine (library, matrix, JSON map, validator, pricing)
Product Setup (Size variation axis, cart item data, line pricing, order-line meta)
Capacity (per-day counts, lead, horizon, closed dates, cap)
Order Manager (statuses cfcb-to-make → cfcb-ready → cfcb-picked-up, cancel & refund, ticket data)
Change (edit in place or replace + refund)
Bakery Dashboard (day rail, orders table, status buttons, print menu, 60 s poll)
Deli lead's actions (Mark ready / Picked up / Not picked up)
Letter prints: season list, totals, cooking, sheets, pickup list
Woo Orders list additions (Bakery column, origin filter)
Epson TM-H6000V on the co-op LAN, TCP 9100
Settings (10 tabs: Capacity & Calendar, Catalogs, Locations, Tickets & Printing, Notifications, Content, Seasonal Specials, Holiday, Tools, Health)
Woo product screen additions (bakery item fields, sizes & prices, own-prices switch)
Import screen (dry run → staged plan → apply)
Season record (cfc_bakery_holiday, states off / preparing / on)
Health tab (registry, cached scan, report) + 10 providers
GitHub Actions (lint PHP 7.4 + node --check, then wpengine/github-action-wpe-site-deploy)
CLI harness tests/cli/run.sh (60 check files, --no-theme run)

front-end map pairs each --cfc-bakery-* with a --wp--preset--* var and a computed clamp() fallback

same :root snapshot inlined into the print document
letter prints inline the snapshot too
literals per element, never var()

lint job: php -l every PHP file on PHP 7.4, node --check every JS file; refuses to deploy on a parse error
wpengine/github-action-wpe-site-deploy to WPE_ENV: coopstg2, path wp-content/plugins/cfc-bakery-orders/

activation hooks never fire on deploy, so cfc_bakery_maybe_upgrade() runs on plugins_loaded

60 check files under tests/cli/checks/, run twice: with the theme and --no-theme
